data.content_ref: inline:The target conflates corroboration of a stance with falsification of the audited content. Two NU verdicts (SRC_006, SRC_008) sharing a falsificationist disposition can sustain a ritual flag without any one of them demonstrating a factual defect in the target's reasoning. The audit standard (§11.3) asks whether adjudication-ritual flags are sustained; the target answers by explaining *why* they persist epistemically, but never establishes that the underlying criticism they encode actually holds against the audited claim. Sustaining a flag is not justified by neighborhood agreement alone — the flag must latch onto a real fault, and the target substitutes social epistemology for that factual link.
